correctness.rationale: The path continuant gives f_(2d+1)=z f_d², so f_n=z^n. The vectors T^j e_1 have distinct last nonzero coordinates, making T a single nilpotent chain. In odd clique width the all-ones matrix is the projection onto constants, yielding one zero block and q−1 unipotent blocks. In even width it has rank one and square zero. The only nontrivial pair is multiplication by x+y in F2[x,y]/(x^n,y²). Over F2[z] with z=x+y, the two generators 1,y have relations z^n+z^(n−1)y and z^n y, since n is odd. The 2-by-2 relation matrix has gcd of entries z^(n−1) and determinant z^(2n), hence Smith factors z^(n−1) and z^(n+1). This independently gives the claimed blocks. The nilpotent entry count is the first time its coordinate is killed; successive kernel-size differences give E_t. For 2^j≤2^(s−1), every recurrent block contributes exactly 2^j to fixed-space dimension, and the total recurrent dimension is Rn. Subtracting successive fixed-state counts and dividing by 2^j gives exact orbit counts; B_(s−1)<B_s. Adjacent even/odd widths have equal R. The one-column case follows because f_d(0)=1 for even d and f_d(1)=0 exactly at d≡2 mod 3; d=4^r satisfies neither singularity condition, and the even-width nilpotent summand commutes with the invertible part. Fresh exact matrix profiles corroborated both parity branches (e.g. ranks of (F+I)^t at n=7,q=2 are 14,12,10,8,6,4,2,1,0; at n=7,q=5 powers of F stabilize at rank 28 at t=7).
residual_risks: The finite checks are examples; they do not assume equality of Jordan type merely from equality of orbit counts. The proof is for synchronous open-neighbour updates over F2 only.

value.rationale: The example family addresses whether a full primitive-cycle census determines how typical or how rapidly reached recurrent states are in a fixed graph-XOR rule. At paired widths it does not: the entire cycle census agrees exactly, with periods growing to 2^s, while the recurrent fractions are one and 2^(−n), and the second system has depth n attained by half its states. The contrast compares differently sized graphs, not identical permutation representations or normalized orbit distributions over all initial states. This controlled mathematical witness and its precise transient law add to the constituent partition and reversibility formulas.
residual_risks: No extension to arbitrary path lengths or equality of normalized orbit frequencies over all configurations is claimed.
